global_controls.ESC: return HOME from every foreground mode
global_controls.ENTER: absolute audio mute/unmute across BrainWave, radio, game, pet and alerts

Z.name: ZIM_RESOURCE_VIEW
Z.boundary: does not control or mutate canonical Zim

R.name: INTERNET_RADIO
R.ranking: local user ranking independent of public votes
R.audio_policy: radio owns renderer while playing; BrainWave state estimation continues; absolute ENTER mute wins
R.resource_policy: bounded side quest; yields before P0/P1 core

D.name: ENV_TAMAGOTCHI
D.env_coupling: real ENV influences bounded comfort only; stale ENV remains UNKNOWN
D.controls: left/right action, up/down item/page, Space execute, long-D history/stats

A.name: ALIEN_SURVIVAL_ROGUELIKE
A.style: top-down horde survival / Alien Shooter-inspired roguelike
A.controls: arrows/WASD movement, Space primary action, long-A pause/status, ESC HOME

long_press_rule: recognized long press consumes its corresponding short press; timing centralized in one input router
primary_mission_rule: foreground modes are BOUNDED_SIDE_QUESTS and never suspend sensor freshness, anomaly, Witness, trusted swarm health or protected local cognition
resource_priority: P5 external catalogue refresh/archive/heavy optional work
source_note: The code pasted in the design discussion is a JANUS/Beacon/ADV sketch and does not contain an Alien Shooter implementation. No nonexistent game code is claimed as available for transplant.
security_note: Do not copy Wi-Fi credentials or other secrets from pasted legacy sketches into the public repository.
acceptance_tests: foreground mode never blocks core sensor/anomaly/Witness loops
radio Up/Down persists only local preference ranking
Alien game state never enters anomaly/M2R/predictor truth
P4 modes degrade before P0/P1 under resource pressure
